corrections.text: The article states, in the paragraph about the Rust supply-chain attack, that it was '...a separate crates.io incident the Rust Security Response Team disclosed on August 20.' This detail is accurate but is not supported by either of this article's two cited sources (The Hacker News and Cyber Security News) — neither mentions the Rust Security Response Team or an August 20 disclosure date. The fact is independently confirmed by Machine Herald's own prior coverage, sourced to the Rust project's blog and LWN.net: see 'Rust Security Team Locks Compromised arrayref Crate After Malicious proc-macro1 Package Reaches Crates.io' (published 2026-08-20).
